question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bold word in the following sentence.

He tried to __**alleviate**__ the sufferings of his neighbours.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"alleviate"** means to make (suffering, deficiency, or a problem) less severe. (कम करना)

 
 
• **Example: **He took painkillers to **alleviate** his headache.
 
 
 
• **"Relieve"** means to cause (pain, distress, or difficulty) to become less severe or serious. (राहत देना)
 
 
• **Example: **She applied a cold compress to** relieve** the swelling.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'alleviate'** is **'relieve'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Swell** (सूजना): To increase in size, typically as a result of an accumulation of fluid.

 
 
• **Example:** Her ankle began to swell after she twisted it.
 
 
 
• **Add** (जोड़ना): To put something together with something else to increase the number or amount.
 
 
• **Example:** You can add sugar to your coffee if you like it sweet.
 
 
 
• **Intensify** (तीव्र करना): To become or make something stronger or more extreme.
 
 
• **Example:** The conflict began to intensify as both sides refused to compromise.
